items.title: Add a smokes aggregator and wire it into the lattice validate run path
items.context: Add a test:smokes (or similar) script that runs the wrapper-root / gitRoot smokes (storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke/suite, gitroot-cwd-routing, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd) and any other currently-orphaned smokes, and make lattice validate execute it (chain into root test, or a validate.command). Decide fast vs --full placement for slower fixture-building smokes.
items.userSees: lattice validate runs the wrapper-root smokes (their output appears in the validate run) and a deliberately-broken smoke makes lattice validate fail.

happy.desc: After wiring, `lattice validate` output lists each newly-gated guard step (process-fact-contract, runtime-fact-contract, evidence-quality, anti-stall, storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke, gitroot-cwd-routing, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd, done-oracle-wrapper-root) and exits PASS.
Root npm test chain runs the new guards in addition to the existing ones; no guard is double-listed (gitroot-cwd-contract appears exactly once).

edge.desc: The slow storydir-inside-gitroot-suite (~7s) and the 160-smoke test:all are NOT in the fast gate but remain reachable via the documented full/CI aggregator path.
Newly added root test:evidence-quality alias resolves to scripts/verify-evidence-quality.mjs and runs green.

adversarial.desc: A guard that is GREEN standalone must also be GREEN (and actually executed, not no-opped) when run inside the chained npm test context (cwd/env parity).

verificationEvidence.note: Post-merge refresh: validate output lists all 8 newly-gated guard steps; validate --json (no --story) status=pass allPass=true commands[].code=0. Battery GREEN after git merge main.
Post-merge refresh: root test chain has the 8 new entries; gitroot-cwd-contract count=1 (regex verified); npm test exit 0 ALL PASS.

Post-merge refresh: storydir-inside-gitroot-suite and test:all absent from fast test chain; test:smokes-full alias = npm run test:storydir-inside-gitroot-suite && npm run test:all (full/CI path). Slow suite stays out of fast gate.
Post-merge refresh: root alias test:evidence-quality => node scripts/verify-evidence-quality.mjs; green standalone and in chain.
Post-merge refresh: all 8 guards GREEN inside chained npm test context (not no-opped); each emits its own pass line; breaking anti-stall flips validate to status=fail proving in-chain execution.

items.title: Verify the aggregated smokes run and pass under lattice validate; a regression blocks
items.context: Confirm lattice validate (and the CLI gate path) now executes the aggregated smokes green, and add a guard/test proving a smoke failure surfaces as a validate failure (no silent skip). Cross-check no double-run / excessive slowdown.
items.userSees: lattice validate GREEN with the smokes included; intentionally breaking one of them turns lattice validate red.

happy.desc: With all guards passing, `lattice validate --story=B-99b6` is GREEN and the REVIEW->TEST gate (same npm test fallback) passes.

edge.desc: Cross-check no excessive slowdown: the fast-gate delta from the newly-added guards stays seconds-scale (sum of fast guards ~8s, no 160-smoke run).

adversarial.desc: Deliberately breaking ONE wired guard/smoke makes `lattice validate` turn RED with that guard reported as the failing step (no silent skip / no swallowed error); reverting restores GREEN.

verificationEvidence.note: With all guards passing, lattice validate --json reports status=pass allPass=true, package.json test script commands[].code=0. The REVIEW->TEST gate (phase-gates runValidateGate) consumes this same validate result, so a passing chain lets the gate pass. The story-scoped validate also gates on verificationEvidence coverage which is now being populated.

Fast-gate delta is seconds-scale: process-fact-contract 2.0s, runtime-fact-contract 2.6s, evidence-quality 0.1s, anti-stall 0.2s, storydir-inside-gitroot-smoke 0.5s, gitroot-cwd-routing 1.4s, bare-gate-gitroot-cwd 0.4s, done-oracle-wrapper-root 0.8s => ~8s total added. The 7s storydir-suite and ~207s 160-smoke test:all stay OUT of the fast gate (behind test:smokes-full). No 160-smoke run in the per-commit/REVIEW->TEST path.

verificationEvidence.command: break test:anti-stall alias -> lattice validate --json -> git restore -> lattice validate --json
verificationEvidence.note: REGRESSION-BLOCKS PROOF: reversibly broke the wired test:anti-stall alias (appended && exit 1, no guard-logic change). lattice validate --json then reported status=fail, allPass=false, summary=Project validation commands failed; ✗ package.json test script: npm test (the failing guard is named in the RED output, no silent skip — npm && short-circuits). git restore package.json reverted; validate --json (no --story) then reported status=pass allPass=true commands[].code=0. Break was NOT committed; worktree package.json is the clean original. Transcripts: /tmp/b99b6-validate-red.json (fail) and /tmp/b99b6-validate-nostory.json (pass).
